Verifying a Florida HVAC License

You can look up active state contractor credentials, license classes (such as Class A or Class B air conditioning contractors), and disciplinary histories directly via the Florida DBPR License Portal or local county building registries. [1] (https://hvacpro.ai/fl/lakeland/contractors/), [2] (https://homequotr.com/contractors/hvac/lakeland)
